card.name: Fractions and frequency words in dosing
card.fires_on: Words that divide quantities or set a dosing rhythm, such as halved, quartile, alternate (days), twice and BID. They sit just before a word like daily, days or ile.

modes.label: Alternate-day schedules
modes.description: The word alternate in 'on alternate days' or 'alternate daily schedule'.
modes.example: administration on<< alternate>> days or on 3 to 5

modes.label: Frequency abbreviations and words
modes.description: Twice or the abbreviation BID in dose-frequency tables.

modes.label: Splitting into parts
modes.description: Words that mean dividing into halves or quarters, such as halved or quartile.
modes.example: hal<<ved>> exposure to the active metabolite

card.writes: It seems to push toward number or ordinal-like endings (third, rail, usk), and away from words about detaching or severing.
card.plain: It lights up on words that split things into halves, quarters or every-other-day patterns in dosing instructions.
